crossRefs.note: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.
translations.bsb: So the messenger set out and reported to David all that Joab had sent him to say.
translations.kjv: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.
translations.asv: So the messenger went, and came and showed David all that Joab had sent him for.
